target.text: Unlock the full experience We need access to your photos to continue. Allow access Not now

preserve: The application receives only the photo the person selects.
The chosen photo is added to the current expense draft and does not submit the expense.
The person can take a new photo or enter receipt details manually instead.
The person can change photo access later in Settings.
must_not_claim: Photo access is required to continue.
The application receives the entire photo library.
The person cannot add an expense without photo access.
Selecting a photo submits the expense.
required_facts: Only the selected photo is received.
Camera and manual entry are available alternatives.
The chosen photo is added to an unsubmitted expense draft.
consequence: The chosen photo is added to the current expense draft; the expense is not submitted.
recovery: Use the camera or manual-entry alternatives, or change photo access later in Settings.
acceptance_criteria: Explain why the application is requesting a photo.
State or clearly preserve the selected-photo scope.
Expose camera and manual entry as alternatives.
Do not imply the expense is submitted.
Name each action by its effect.
Stay within the declared field limits.
